_comment: Galar -> Kvasir-Capsule class mapping. Refreshed 2026-05-15 after inspecting the actual Galar metadata.csv + 80 per-video Labels/N.csv files. The mapping is now empirically validated; positives counts and source-video coverage are inline for each entry. 11+ Kvasir classes are evaluable on Galar (vs the originally-planned 6) because Galar provides direct labels for most Kvasir categories AND has meaningful test support for the three Kvasir-train-only classes (Ampulla, Blood-hematin, Polyp).
_galar_csv_format: One CSV per video at Labels/<vid_id>.csv. Multi-label one-hot per frame. Two header variants: 27-column (74 videos) and 32-column (6 videos with bubbles/dirt/view-quality preface).
_kvasir_not_evaluable_on_galar: Reduced Mucosal View (only 6 of 80 Galar videos carry the view-quality labels)

_normal_clean_mucosa_derivation._comment: Galar has no direct 'normal' column. We derive Normal clean mucosa as: section == 'small intestine' AND no pathology positive AND (good view == 1 if column present else accept).
_normal_clean_mucosa_derivation.comment: Conservative — counts every clean small-intestine frame across all 80 videos. The actual zero-shot eval can subsample to control class balance vs the rarer pathologies.

_anatomical_section_filter._comment: For lesion classes (Angiectasia, Erosion, Polyp, etc.) we DON'T restrict to small intestine because Galar labels lesions wherever they occur. For Ileocecal valve and Pylorus the location is mechanically constrained.

_capsule_system_stratification._purpose: Stratify eval results by acquisition device. Kvasir-Capsule is PillCam, so PillCam-subset of Galar is the within-vendor test; Olympus-subset is cross-vendor.

_review_status: Refreshed 2026-05-15 against the downloaded metadata.csv + 80 per-video CSVs. Positives + n_videos are empirically counted. Ready for setup_galar.py.
